lines: {target}? Sound travels farther than sense. I would stay close enough to hear the bell.
If anyone heads for Deep Dark, tell them: Walk soft and do not open every chest. I will be at the bell.
Sculk hears what pride forgets. I will remember that from near the bell.
Deep Dark is no small story. Running the wrong way is still running.
I will remember Deep Dark as darkness that listens back. I will stay where I can hear the bell.
{target}? Stone teeth hang above and wait below. I would stay close enough to hear the bell.
If anyone heads for Dripstone Caves, tell them: Look up as often as you look down. I will be at the bell.
Pointed stone makes every stumble serious. I will remember that from near the bell.
Dripstone Caves is no small story. Running the wrong way is still running.
I will remember Dripstone Caves as a cave that bites from both directions. I will stay where I can hear the bell.
{target}? Pretty caves still have long drops. I would stay close enough to hear the bell.
If anyone heads for Lush Caves, tell them: Watch the vines and the holes between them. I will be at the bell.
Glow berries light paths that may not be safe. I will remember that from near the bell.
Lush Caves is no small story. Running the wrong way is still running.
I will remember Lush Caves as a cave trying very hard to look harmless. I will stay where I can hear the bell.
